turns.replyText:
What's your return and refund policy?

Hi, here’s the overview of our return and refund policy:

• Live plants
We do not accept returns on plants.

Roses are covered by a one-year guarantee.
Perennials are covered by a 90-day guarantee.
Bulbs are covered by a failure-to-bloom guarantee.

If a warranty claim is approved, you’ll receive store credit valid for one year.

• Gardening tools and other hard goods
These can be returned within 30 days of delivery if they are in new, unused condition. Opened or used merchandise is not eligible for return, except gloves, which may be returned opened if they’re in the original packaging. Return shipping costs are the customer’s responsibility.

• Fertilizers, soil amendments, and treatments
These are final sale and are not covered by warranty.

• Garden Markers
Custom engraved tags and stakes are non-returnable.

You can find the full policy here: Our Guarantee

If you want, I can also break it down for a specific item you’re considering.
